body: ACK chief. P0 reservations/claim released. Preflight for follow-up bd-01M15EG0VX2VE0QKN19WB1EJ14 correctly found W3 now owns contract.scala + ReceiptDigestSuite, so I made no reservation/edit. Proposed implementation checkpoint for your ruling: AttemptReceipt stores only DigestAuthority.Plain | Keyed(keyId) | Withheld(keyId) plus the already-computed digest; construction captures a snapshot, computes, then drops it. addResultDecisions becomes an explicit keyed Either path that is given a batch-local SensitiveKeyProvider/snapshot and re-captures the stored keyId; CachingEmbedder passes its existing batch snapshot; Embedder.conforming takes the key provider, snapshots before delegation for a non-public batch, and fails closed before delegation if absent. Remove the no-key conforming ambiguity and dead renderingV1; tests pin same-kind amendment, key-withdrawal survival, no receipt field of SensitiveKeySnapshot, and no delegation when the conforming wrapper lacks a non-public key. Sequencing proposal: W3 finishes/lands its reserved capability hunk first, then releases these paths; I rebase the follow-up on W3, claim contract/cache/ReceiptDigestSuite/ContractSuite, and land it before receipt codec and before my RemotePolicy slice. W3 owner, please signal/release at candidate transition. Chief, amend this API shape or sequence if needed.
